name: Fixable Severity at least Important in Application Layers
description: Alert on deployments with fixable vulnerabilities with a Severity Rating at least Important in application layers (base image layers are excluded)
rationale: Known vulnerabilities in your application layers make it easier for adversaries to exploit your application. You can fix these high-severity vulnerabilities by updating to a newer version of the affected component(s). Base image vulnerabilities are the responsibility of the base image maintainer.
remediation: Use your package manager to update to a fixed version in future builds or speak with your security team to mitigate the vulnerabilities in your application layers.
